frame.origin: ground under the first video camera (approx.)

scale.method: assumed hand-held camera height 1.51 m, checked against crosswalk stripe period (~1.0 m, GB 5768.3)
scale.note: DA3 metric depth suggested +23 %, rejected (inconsistent with road markings)

frame.gltf_note: web/GLB exports are Y-up (glTF convention): x_gltf = x, y_gltf = z, z_gltf = -y

lighting.sky: thin high overcast; sun disc visible through cloud
lighting.method: sun direction triangulated from the saturated sun blob in 13 frames

camera.solver: pycolmap 4.2 incremental SfM, 859/859 frames registered, 0.54 px mean reprojection error
